original_query: select  	s_store_name, 	i_item_desc, 	sc.revenue, 	i_current_price, 	i_wholesale_cost, 	i_brand  from store, item,      (select ss_store_sk, avg(revenue) as ave  	from  	    (select  ss_store_sk, ss_item_sk,  		     sum(ss_sales_price) as revenue  		from store_sales, date_dim  		where ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_month_seq between 1178 and 1178+11     and ss_sales_price / ss_list_price BETWEEN 45 * 0.01 AND 55 * 0.01  		group by ss_store_sk, ss_item_sk) sa  	group by ss_store_sk) sb,      (select  ss_store_sk, ss_item_sk, sum(ss_sales_price) as revenue  	from store_sales, date_dim  	where ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_month_seq between 1178 and 1178+11   and ss_sales_price / ss_list_price BETWEEN 45 * 0.01 AND 55 * 0.01  	group by ss_store_sk, ss_item_sk) sc  where sb.ss_store_sk = sc.ss_store_sk and        sc.revenue <= 0.1 * sb.ave and        s_store_sk = sc.ss_store_sk and        i_item_sk = sc.ss_item_sk        and i_manager_id BETWEEN 83 and 87        and s_state in ('IN','MI','WI')  order by s_store_name, i_item_desc limit 100;
rewritten_query:
WITH relevant_sales AS (
    SELECT ss.ss_store_sk,
           ss.ss_item_sk,
           s.s_store_name,
           SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) AS revenue
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d
      ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN store s
      ON s.s_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk
    WHERE d.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1178 AND 1189
      AND ss.ss_sales_price / ss.ss_list_price BETWEEN 0.45 AND 0.55
      AND s.s_state IN ('IN', 'MI', 'WI')
    GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk, ss.ss_item_sk, s.s_store_name
),
store_item_avg AS (
    SELECT r.ss_store_sk,
           r.ss_item_sk,
           r.s_store_name,
           r.revenue,
           AVG(r.revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY r.ss_store_sk) AS ave
    FROM relevant_sales r
)
SELECT sia.s_store_name,
       i.i_item_desc,
       sia.revenue,
       i.i_current_price,
       i.i_wholesale_cost,
       i.i_brand
FROM store_item_avg sia
JOIN item i
  ON i.i_item_sk = sia.ss_item_sk
WHERE sia.revenue <= 0.1 * sia.ave
  AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 83 AND 87
ORDER BY sia.s_store_name, i.i_item_desc
LIMIT 100;

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: The two identical aggregate subqueries (sa/sc) over store_sales and date_dim are computed twice. Rewrite as a single CTE `relevant_sales` and use `AVG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY ss_store_sk)` instead of a self-join against the per-store average subquery. This halves the aggregation workload and removes the extra join.
Constant folded `45 * 0.01` / `55 * 0.01` into 0.45 / 0.55, and `1178 + 11` into 1189. Semantics unchanged.

Replaced implicit comma joins with explicit JOIN syntax. Pushed the `s_state IN ('IN','MI','WI')` filter into the revenue CTE by joining `store` early — safe because the state filter only removes whole stores and therefore does not change the per-store average of the retained stores. Store name is carried through the CTE so `store` does not need to be joined again in the outer query.

The `i_manager_id` filter is deliberately NOT pushed below the average computation, since the original average includes all items regardless of manager. It is kept as a post-aggregation filter to preserve equivalence.
